 FT: Stuttgart 2-3 Borussia M'gladbach 
 Image source, Getty Images Borussia M'gladbach hold on to earn their first win of the season, beating Stuttgart and avoid making unwanted history.
 It's also Alexander Blessin first win as the their manager.

 Post published at 87 mins 87 mins 
 Stuttgart 2-3 Borussia M'gladbach 
 Stuttgart have a bee in their bonnet and it seems like we're going right to the wire with this one.
 The home side are pushing for an equaliser and Borussia M'gladbach are trying to hold on to their lead.
 2 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Ermedin Demirovic published at 21:18 BST 21:18 BST 
 Stuttgart 2-3 Borussia M'gladbach 
 Expect things to get nervy for Borussia Monchengadbach now.
 Stuttgart are back in it after Jamie Leweling's ball in from the right is headed home form inside the six-yard box by Ermedin Demirivoc.
 That's Demirovic's second goal of the night. Can Stuttgart pull this back against an increasingly shaky Monchengladbach?
 Image source, Getty Images 
 4 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 82 min 82 min 
 Stuttgart 1-3 Borussia M'gladbach 
 Good save from the keeper!
 Stiller's free-kick doesn't really trouble him.
 The game had started to settle after Borussia M'gladbach's third goal, but there is still time for Stuttgart to get something from this game.

Win this and we will get in to Europe this season. Mark my words!

 Former Bayern Munich youth player David Herold replaces Fabio Chiarodia for Borussia M'gladbach.
 1 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Wael Mohya published at 20:57 BST 20:57 BST 
 Stuttgart 1-3 Borussia M'gladbach 
 And it's the man who plays "without fear"! 
 It's a scramble but Borussia Monchengladbach won't care and neither will their fans.
 They win the ball high up in Stuttgart's half and Mohya's initial shot somehow gets through Seimen in the Stuttgart goal.
 Ramon Hendriks slides in to clear it off the line but Stuttgart are at sixes and sevens and eventually it is crossed in for Mohya to head home from a few yards out.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Mohya plays 'without fear' published at 20:55 BST 20:55 BST 
 Stuttgart 1-2 Borussia M'gladbach 
 German Bundesliga 
 Yesterday Borussia M'gladbach manager Alexander Blessin was praising the man who created that second goal Wael Mohya, and this is what he had to say. 
 "He’s very open-minded and plays without fear," Blessin said.
 He’s confident and is eager to learn. He’s got quality both on and off the ball. 
 "He works really hard to win the ball back, can beat players one-on-one and gives us an outlet when we’re under pressure. 
 "That fearlessness is good for us. But it would be wrong to put all the responsibility on his shoulders. We need everyone to play their part."
 He must've known something we didn't.

 SUBSTITUTION published at 54 mins 54 mins 
 Stuttgart 1-2 Borussia M'gladbach 
 Three substitutes for Stuttgart.
 German striker Deniz Undav on for Dženan Pejčinović, midfielder Leo Sauer replaced by Jamie Jeweling, and Bilal El Khannouss for Lorenz Assignon.

 Post published at 20:47 BST 20:47 BST 
 Stuttgart 1-2 Borussia M'gladbach 
 Now be honest - who would have thought Borussia M'gladbach would be 2-1 up here?
 If they hold on to this they are on to pick up their first points of the season after seven Bundesliga matches.
 0 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Shuto Machino published at 50 min 50 min 
 Stuttgart 1-2 Borussia M'gladbach 
 Borussia M'gladbach have the lead! 
 Shuto Machino finds the back of the net with a brilliant finish, but Wael Mohya did all the hard work to make the goal happen!
 Mohya does so well creating the space on the left, dribbling between defenders and showing fancy footwork and strength.
 Once he untangles himself, he simply putting it on a plate for Machino.
 Image source, Getty Images
